signals.text: Penders error & Palmer sees red - player ratings for Chelsea v Spurs. Goalkeeper Mike Penders endures a difficult first Premier League start, scoring an own goal in Spurs' 2-0 win at Chelsea. Here's how we - and you - rated the players.
